events.description: A cliff of {tokens[0]} tokens was unlocked from Liquidity on {timestamp}

notes: 50% of supply seeds a single-sided FWA/ETH Uniswap v4 position at genesis, modeled as unlocked at TGE
Emissions started 2026-07-20 (when acquisitions were first enabled) and run for 15 days
Depositor rewards are tracked at accrual (settled per listing on claim, reprice, or removal) and purchaser rewards are tracked at claim, so both lag the underlying 1%/day streams
Post-emission fee buybacks route bought-back FWA to depositors, purchasers, and burn, this is recirculated supply and is not tracked as here.

Airdrop.methodology: 20% of supply funded FWAClaim, a Merkle token claim for wallets in the v1 snapshot at Ethereum block 25,452,023.

snapshot-claims.name: v1 Snapshot Claims
snapshot-claims.methodology: Tracks FWA transfers out of the FWAClaim contract as snapshot wallets claim.

Airdrop (Unclaimed).methodology: Remainder of the 20% snapshot allocation still held by FWAClaim. The claim owner can rescue unclaimed tokens.

airdrop-unclaimed.name: Airdrop (Unclaimed)
airdrop-unclaimed.methodology: 20% of supply funded to FWAClaim, minus claims already tracked on-chain.

Depositor Rewards.methodology: 15% of supply streamed to depositors pro-rata by sqrt(listing backing). Tracks DepositorTokensAccrued events, emitted when pending rewards settle to a depositor on claim, reprice, or listing removal.

depositor-rewards.name: Depositor Rewards
depositor-rewards.methodology: 15% of supply streamed to depositors pro-rata by sqrt(listing backing). Tracks DepositorTokensAccrued events, emitted when pending rewards settle to a depositor on claim, reprice, or listing removal.

Purchaser Rewards.methodology: 15% of supply as daily pots split pro-rata over each day's successful acquisitions. Tracks PurchaserTokensClaimed events for the 15 emission epochs only; post-emission pots funded by fee buybacks are recirculated supply and excluded.

purchaser-rewards.name: Purchaser Rewards
purchaser-rewards.methodology: 15% of supply as daily pots split pro-rata over each day's successful acquisitions. Tracks PurchaserTokensClaimed events for the 15 emission epochs only; post-emission pots funded by fee buybacks are recirculated supply and excluded.

Incentives (Undistributed).methodology: Remainder of the 30% emission allocation held by FWARewards and not yet accrued or claimed. Unclaimed epoch pots can be swept by the owner after an epoch closes empty.

incentives-undistributed.name: Incentives (TBD)
incentives-undistributed.methodology: 30% of supply funded to FWARewards, minus depositor and purchaser rewards already tracked on-chain.
